matrix.comparison_design: One factor at a time plus two prespecified coverage-by-abundance corners; not a full factorial.
matrix.blocked_condition: 1:9 target:background ratio is NOT_RUN until generator audit confirms the ratio can be set and measured exactly.

blocked_factors.blocker: Current adapter does not expose k-mer selection; separately reviewed, version-compatible options and frozen values are required.

blocked_factors.limitation: Low-complexity condition appears in the recovery block; it is not fully crossed with every SPAdes factor.

assemblers.version_requirement: Freeze exact version output and executable SHA-256; M35 summary does not pin it.

analysis.technical_repeats: Summarize within family-condition; never count as independent families.

analysis.held_out_unblinding: Only after locked design, tools, and analyses validate.
analysis.unevaluable_positive_rule: No supported assembly means unevaluable, not a positive or negative detection.
